title: Delivery & Pickup Services Tariff: Evening Express Supplement
content:
The evening express supplement of a Delivery & Pickup Services express order depends on the end of the express order's promised window, in store local time, as its order record shows it. The supplement forms part of the express fee on top of the express speed charge.

| End of the promised window | Evening express supplement |
|---|---|
| 20:00 or later | $1.75 |
| 18:00 or later but before 20:00 | $0.90 |
| before 18:00 | none |

## Edges (hypothetical window ends)

| Promised window ends | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 17:59 | none |
| 18:00 | $0.90 |
| 19:59 | $0.90 |
| 20:00 | $1.75 |
| 21:15 | $1.75 |

An express order placed at 17:10 on a plan with a 60-minute express promise has a window ending at 18:10 and carries $0.90; one placed at 19:05 ends at 20:05 and carries $1.75.
